question: Why does the Haber–Bosch process, as described in the lithium-mediated ammonia review, run at pressures of only 1-5 atm?
rendered: The Haber–Bosch process is not described in the lithium-mediated ammonia review as running at pressures of only 1-5 atm. In fact, the review mentions that the Haber–Bosch process operates under extreme temperatures (400–650 °C) and pressures (200–400 atm).
